The letter {{AurB|r}} was the eighteenth letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "resh", and had the value of /R/.<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
